# Distribución por causas principales (top 10)

```{r top10_causas, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(scales)

top10_causas <- read.csv("NCHS_Leading_Causes.csv") %>%
  filter(Cause.Name != "All causes", State == "United States") %>%
  mutate(Deaths = as.numeric(gsub("[.]", "", Deaths))) %>%
  group_by(Cause.Name) %>%
  summarise(total_muertes = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_muertes)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

top10_causas %>%
  mutate(total_muertes = scales::comma(total_muertes)) %>%
  rename("Causa" = Cause.Name,
         "Total de muertes" = total_muertes) %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Top 10 causas de muerte en EE.UU. (1999-2017)",
    align = c("l", "r")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center",
    font_size = 12
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, background = "#04376B", color = "white", bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "25em") %>%
  footnote(
    general = "Datos del CDC - Leading Causes of Death",
    general_title = "Fuente:",
    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE
  )
```
